# google_cloud_identity_allowlisted_domain

A domain on the external sharing allowlist (trusted domains) of the Google
Workspace or Cloud Identity customer that the caller belongs to.


To get more information about AllowlistedDomain, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/identity/docs/reference/rest/v1/allowlistedDomains)
* How-to Guides
    * [Allowlisted Domains API overview](https://cloud.google.com/identity/docs/concepts/overview-allowlisted-domains)
    * [Setting up the Allowlisted Domains API](https://cloud.google.com/identity/docs/how-to/setup-allowlisted-domains)

~> **Warning:** The Allowlisted Domains API only accepts the
`https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-identity.allowlisteddomains` or
`https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-identity` OAuth scopes; the provider's
default `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform` scope is rejected.
Set `scopes` in the provider configuration accordingly.
The API operates on the customer of the calling user, and the caller must be
a Google Workspace / Cloud Identity administrator with the allowlisted domain
management privilege (for example, a super admin). Service accounts must use
domain-wide delegation to act as such an administrator.


## Example Usage - Cloud Identity Allowlisted Domain Basic


```hcl
resource "google_cloud_identity_allowlisted_domain" "allowlisted_domain" {
  domain = "example.com"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `domain` -
  (Required)
  The domain to add to the allowlist, e.g. `example.com`. The domain must not
  be one of the customer's own (primary or alias) domains.


* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `{{name}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the allowlisted domain, assigned by the server.
  Format: `allowlistedDomains/{allowlisted_domain}`.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import AllowlistedDomain using identity values. For example:
